gaps.title: Quick quizzes cover 3 of 15 lesson guides
gaps.detail: The <details>-based quick quiz exists on the 3 exemplar lessons (alphabet, hello, sentence-structure); the other 12 lesson guides have no quiz yet. Content gap carried from Phase 4, not an interaction defect.

gaps.title: Home markets strip hover-lift is already neutralised
gaps.detail: .mkt:hover{transform:translateY(-6px)} exists but a later .mkt:hover{transform:none} rule overrides it, so the JS-rendered market cards never lifted on hover. Visual polish item, not a clickability defect.

gaps.title: Live deploy / push remain owner-gated
gaps.detail: Carried from Phase 3: no push credentials in this environment and the remote was reset to one squashed commit, so ekguru.shop still serves the pre-Phase-2 build. This Phase 5 build is verified locally only.
